caption: The drawing depicts a knee-length dress with a fitted bodice, off-the-shoulder puffed short sleeves, and a full gathered skirt. The dress features a plaid pattern composed of brown, beige, and light blue lines, forming a grid-like design. The bodice has horizontal and vertical alignment to the plaid, a gathered or ruched upper section, and is cinched at the waist by a matching belt or waistband. The skirt is pleated at the waist, allowing the plaid pattern to flow vertically and diagonally as it spreads toward the hem. The background of the drawing is a plain light beige color, and the name "ELEANOR GAUSSER" is lightly inscribed near the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Child's Dress
